notes.title: Update Version V1.0.5.8
notes.content:
1.- Changed weapon's sounds to default weapons.
2.- Fixed issue on some not despawned objects, that will improve the performance in the server and client side.
3.- Fixed issue in the spacefighter HUD not showing the primary weapons initially.
4.- Changed the shooting methods on the client side to avoid interruptions when the
network latency is high.
5.- Fixed minor bugs.

Items on review:

1. Condor Spaceship weapons.
2. Stealth Components
3. Blue Lightning and Heavy Red Beams
3. Map Isabella Island (Planet Earth).
